This is truly the best gents’ tailor in Powai! I got the same fabric stitched in a Jodhpuri style at an affordable price within just a few days. The fit is perfect, the stitching is excellent, and the suit is very comfortable. The staff is extremely supportive, cooperative, and experienced.

I highly recommend everyone to visit them for all kinds of stitching needs. Cheap and the best! ❤️👌🏻
